items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Bobby Martin's band. Oh, Johnny Russell, myself, Glyn Paque, me, Bob McRae and Kaiser Marshall.

ctx.x: Well, how did you come to go to Europe?
It's funny. You must have been in the band when I went to the Savoy in '37. You must have been in the band then, because you didn't leave until June!
